question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Dejection
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Cheer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Dejection"** means a state of sadness or low spirits; feeling downcast or disheartened. (निराशा)
 
 
• **Example:** After losing the match, he sank into dejection and refused to talk to anyone.
 
 
 
• **"Cheer"** refers to a state of happiness or joy; feeling uplifted and positive. (उल्लास)
 
 
• **Example:** The festive decorations brought cheer to everyone in the neighborhood.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Dejection'** is **'Cheer'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Glamour** (ग्लैमर): Attractive or exciting quality that makes certain people or things seem appealing.
 
 
• **Example:** The movie star's life is filled with glamour and luxury.
 
 
 
• **Malnutrition** (कुपोषण): Lack of proper nutrition caused by not having enough food or not eating enough healthy food.
 
 
• **Example:** Children in impoverished areas often suffer from malnutrition.
 
 
 
• **Stagnancy** (स्थिरता): Lack of activity, growth, or development.
 
 
• **Example:** The stagnancy in the economy has led to increased unemployment rates.
